name: General Practitioner 2
source: Live the life of TWO doctors in this brand-new medical simulated Visual Novel. Andrew and Julie are siblings and MDs and they recently inherited a once-renowned medical clinic from their aunt. Join them in rebuilding the clinic, hiring staff and living their lives.
translation: 在这部全新的医疗模拟视觉小说中，同时体验两位医生的人生吧！安德鲁与朱莉是一对皆拥有医学博士学位的兄妹（姐弟），两人近期从姑妈手中继承了一家昔日声名显赫的诊所。跟随他们一同重振诊所声威、招募医护员工，并谱写各自的人生篇章。
